name: ext1_escape_avoids_guard_and_lasers
description: Finds safe path 0 -> 2 -> 3 when sensor 1 is active and guard is at zone 1 at at_time=1.

name: ext2_escape_blocked_by_guard_at_exit
description: Returns NO_PATH when guard is patrolling the exit zone (zone 3) at at_time=3.

name: ext3_escape_locked_on_critical_alert
description: Returns LOCKED when alert_level is CRITICAL (3).
